'''Exigar''' was a polluted [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], surveys of Exigar detected unusual mutations in the planet's flora, and further investigation revealed that the pollution was causing abnormal variations in native lifeforms.<ref name="Mission" />
